## Medium Barracuda (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 N Medium animal (aquatic)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 27 (3d8+3)  
 **Fort** +4, **Ref** +5, **Will** +2  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +4 (1d6+1/19–20)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 14, **Con** 13, **Int** 1, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 2  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 15 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Improved Critical (bite), Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse B  
 **Skills** Perception +9, Swim +14; **Racial Modifiers** Medium barracudas use their Dexterity modifier for Swim checks.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any aquatic  
 **Organization** pair, pack (2–5), or school (6–11)  
 **Treasure** none
